evals.prompt: I want to build a roguelike dungeon crawler — procedurally generated dungeons, turn-based combat, pixel art. PC only. The player picks a class at the start (Warrior, Rogue, or Mage), finds items and equipment in dungeons, and fights through floors with a boss every 5 levels. Permadeath but with meta-progression unlocks between runs. Please create a full PRD for this game.
evals.expected_output: A complete markdown PRD covering: game overview, core mechanics (classes, combat, items, progression), full Unity technical architecture with MonoBehaviour/ScriptableObject design, milestones with MVP definition, and a SDD handoff section with feature breakdowns and system contracts.
expectations: Output is a markdown file saved to the outputs folder
PRD contains a Game Overview section with elevator pitch, genre, and platform
PRD contains a Core Mechanics section covering the three classes, turn-based combat, and permadeath
PRD contains a Unity Technical Architecture section with MonoBehaviour class names and responsibilities
PRD contains at least one ScriptableObject design (e.g. for classes or items)
PRD contains a Milestones section with an MVP definition
PRD contains a SDD Handoff section (Section 5) with at least one Feature Breakdown entry
PRD contains system contracts with C# interface signatures in Section 5.2
Assumptions made by Claude are labeled as such in the document
